goal: show selected object type, validity and dimensions
positive_oracle: Select box shows type, bounding box dimensions, geometry validity sourced from model
negative_oracle: Missing BRep must show unavailable measurement, not zero volume claim

behaviour_reference.source: OM9_Milestones/M01 - CAD Shell, Viewport/L2-03-14 - Febe Matrix Layers Objectinfo Superselect/reference/text/m8book1__p32-34__using-info-settings-menu.md
behaviour_reference.quote: It displays the type of object and important information about it: surface or polysurface … closed or open … valid or invalid … and point count (for curves), or surface count (for polysurfaces).
behaviour_reference.decision: The label is drawn in the object's layer colour and names the type, the size and the validity; a measurement the model does not have is written as unavailable, never as zero.

method: Behavioural source: the extracted Matrix9 manual shipped with the milestone. QymCAD only for label technique.

planned_anchors.what_is_missing: QymCAD has no object information label.

implemented_api_before_this_task: om9-core: Geometry { Brep, NativeBrep, Point, Curve, Surface, Mesh, Cloud, Instance }, Bounds { Unknown, Empty, Finite } and Geometry::validate(&Limits)
no object-information type existed: nothing could say the type, the size or the validity of a selected object
gap_found_by_this_task: There was no object-information model at all, so the overlay the manual describes could not be opened without inventing its fields.

Added object_info.rs: Measurement (Size or Unavailable(reason)), ObjectInfo (kind, dimensions, valid: Option<bool>, detail, colour) and Document::object_info(id, limits). The negative oracle is structural: a geometry whose bounds are not computed is Unavailable, and validity is None when it cannot be judged, so no zero and no invented pass can be shown.

RED is API-level and stated as such: the model did not exist, so no earlier behaviour could fail; the fixtures (I1..I5, J1..J4) pin the rules, including J1 'an unavailable measurement is never a zero size'.
The painted in-viewport label is NOT done: it is recorded in api.md §3 and in the manual checklist as the next slice.
reuse_decision: ADD the object-information model from the manual's field list; the label painting reuses the existing viewport painting when it is done.
